items.title: 52263_Sonny Greer oral history interview
items.q: We had that. ... He just told Duke he was tired of traveling, he wanted to stay in New York.

ctx.x: Yeah, and you pronounced his name Breau, right?
Right. And he read this and he came up and after he read that he decided he wanted to be a leader or something like that and then he left the band then. Is that how you remember it?
